build_roi_head_template: build a RoIHeadTemplate instance with num_class and model_cfg for 3D object detection ROI refinement
create_fc_layers: create fully connected layers with Conv1d, BatchNorm1d, and ReLU for ROI head feature processing
run_proposal_layer: run the proposal layer to perform NMS on batch box predictions and extract ROI regions
review_assign_targets: review the assign_targets method that performs canonical transformation and coordinate rotation for ROI targets
test_get_loss: test the get_loss method to compute combined classification and regression loss for RCNN training
